main_body: A wooden feed trough filled with green fodder (hay/grass heap with yellow flecks) on top of a brown wooden front face, drawn as a wide low box about 32px wide and 11 rows tall.
top_band: Green fodder heap at rows 4-8 (several greens, with yellow flecks), then a cream highlight row 9 as the front-rim edge, then orange-brown rim row 10. This is a contents surface seen from above, about 5 rows.
evidence: Column x=16: rows 4-8 are a green fodder surface (L 110-173), row 9 is a cream front-rim highlight (L=239), row 10 an orange lip (L=157), row 11 a very dark shadow line (L=38), rows 12-13 the mid-brown front plank (L=124) and row 14 a dark outline. The heap of contents rises above the front rim and reads as a visible interior from above, with a clear step to the front face. The front has dark inset panel edges and a shadow row under the rim. It is a thin and simple piece, but it follows the 3/4 structure: top surface, front edge line, shadow, front face. The front face is short (rows 10-14, with the plank only 2 rows), but the 5-row contents surface is a legitimate top.

style.evidence: The candidate has 13 distinct colours and a median of 12 per tile, against 40 and 38 colours for the references (17 and 20 per tile). It is lower, but it is a small, simple piece, and it has no flat fills (0% coverage). The greens carry about 4-5 steps with yellow flecks and light highlights. The outline is a dark brown (0% neutral share), so it is tinted to the material rather than a sticker black. The wood front is fairly plain, with a few mid-brown planks and dark dividers, so the texture is only moderate. Overall it sits somewhat below the references in richness but is not shallow or sticker-like.
